transcription: Maruva anoyevedza ane ruvara rutsvuku neorenji neyero akawanda.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Motokari yakapaka mujinga yemukomberedzo wemusha wakagadzirwa nesimbi. Motokari iyi ine ruvara rwe sirivheri uye mune murume arimo akagara pasi arikuchaira. Mavhiri e motokari iyi ane ruvara rutema uye ruvara rwe sirivheri pakati.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Nzvimbo  yemabhizimusi yezvitoro nemisika zvakavakwa panzvimbo iyi,zvitoro zvacho zvidiki uye zvakavakwa zvakasiyana siyana zvimwe zvakapendewa zvimwe hazvisati zvimwe hazvisati zvatopera kuvakwa,misika yakavakwa nematanda inaiswa marata pamusoro imwe ikaiswa mapepa kuti pasapinda mvura nezuva.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Vakomana vatatu vari kufamba mumugwagwa une tara. Mumwe chete ari pakati akabata mazimbwa maviri arikuburisa marimi awo akasungwa nengetani.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Tiredhisheni, varume navakadzi vakapfeka zvetiredhisheni , varume vakasunga mucheka unemavara mavara muhuro uchivhara mapendekete, vakadzi  vane zvavakaisa mumusoro zvakagadzirwa nechuma.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Pane imba yakavakwa zvakanaka. Imba iyi ine rimwe gonhi rakavhurika, uyezve imba iyi ine mafafitera akawanda. Imba yakapfirirwa nema tiles, uyezve pedyo nayo pane miti.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mugwagwa wakarebenuka pari kuonekwa nechekumhiri. Vanhu vaviri vari kufamba . Pane muti uri padivi pemugwagwa wakanamirwa chipepa cheruvara ruchena.  Zvakare pari kuonekwa pane uswa hwakaoma mumadivi.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Panzvimbo yekutengesera  pane ma shedhi akapfirirwa nemarata, uye panemugwagwa unopinda nepakati.  Pane Masagi  akawaridzwa.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Munhukadzi ari parunhare akapfeka dhuku ine ruvara rwebhurawuni. Muti une mashizha ane ruvara rwakatsvukuruka.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Zimuti zihombe rine mabazi akawanda netumashizha tudiki.Pazasi pezimuti pane maruva aripo ane ruvara rwegirini nekayero.Nechepamberi pane mudhuri wegireyi.Padivi pemudhuri pane karuva kekamuti kane ruvara rwegirini kakatumbuka mafarawuzi epingi.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mukadzi anemusika wekutengesa hembe nemabhegi ekurongedza , pane mabhegi matema, matsvuku ebhurauni nehembe dzeruvara rwebhuruu negirini mushedhi yakagadzirwa nemaasibhesitosi.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Imba ine marata ine chidziro chesimende chine ruvara rwekirimu. Ine mukomberedzo  wemba wakavakwa  nezvitinha nesimende rwakabatana negedhe rine ruvara rutsvuku. Imba iyi mukati munetenge rine ruvara rwegirinhi.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mudhuri wakavakwa uchiratidza kuti wakakomberedza musha , nechemukati memudhuri murikubuda miti mikuru mimwe yakasvibira chose, panze pane sora rinoratidza kuti ravakundooma zvichibva zvatizivisa kuti rave nenguva risina kumbonayiwa nemvura kana kuwana mwando.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mudhorobha motokari zhinji dziri kufamba mumugwagwa. Padivi pane vanhu vakawanda vari kufamba uyezve zvivakwa zvakawanda zvakakura.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Murume akamira akabata gasi tengi muruoko rweku rudyi. Kumberi kwake kune murume akamira akabereka bhegi. Kuruboshwe kwavo kune mabhanana akarongwa.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Chivakwa chakakura chine ruvara rwemeruni chinoratidza kuti ikereke yevatendi yeWatch Tower. Parutivi pane muti wakakura.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Masitepusi anoratidza kuva mukati meimba. Ane uriri hwamataira uye pane mudhuri une zvidhinha zvitsvuku zvisina kupurasitiwa.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Michero yakagadzikwa patafu yepuranga, michero iyi mina uyezve iri yerudzi rweguava, muchero umwe wacho wakachekwa nepakati kuratidza modzi iri mukati uyezve neruvara rwakatsvuka mukati.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Motokari  dziri kufamba mumugwagwa wetara. Nechekurudyi kune mumwe mugwagwa wemavhu wakazarawo marara une mitiwo nechekudivi kwavo. Pakati pawo pane miti mihombe nemidiki.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mureza une mavara akasiyana siyana. Tichibva kumusoro tichienda kuzasi mureza uyu une ruvara rwuchena kwouya ruvara rwegirinhi kwouya ruvara rwutsvuku. Mavara aya ane zvaanomirira pamureza wese.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Vanhu vazhinji varikufamba pamusika. Padivi panevarume vakagara pazvigaro uyezve nengoro yakazara zvekudya zvirikutengeswa.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Vanhu vari kufamba mukati medhorobha vakafuratirana nemotikari dzakawanda dzimwe dziri mumugwagwa nedzimwe dzakatomira padivi pezvitoro. Koita imba hombe yemuturikanidzwa iri kudivi kwemotikari idzi.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Vanhu vari kufamba pakati pemidhuri. Vakomana vaviri vari kuruboshwe vakabereka mabhegi avo kumusana. Koita vamwe vakamira vari nechokurudyi pakati pezvivakwa zviviri.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mwanasikana anemusoro wakarukwa zvimagodi zvinokwana zvishanu pamberi zvakapoteredzwa nebvudzi rekutenga, zvakakomberedzwa nemitsara yakarukwa godha. Nechekumashure kune bvudzi rekutenga rakarembera richienda kugotsi rakagonyoroka - gonyoroka.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Pane migwagwa miviri irikufambidzana inoti umwe wevanhu neumwe wemotokari. Migwagwa iyi yakaghanurwa nemiti iripakaiti. Miti iyi inosanganisira yemijakaranda.
